displayName: Prism ML AMD ROCm/HIP llama.cpp (Windows - RX 9070 XT / RDNA 4)
description: AMD ROCm/HIP accelerated llama.cpp engine with native Prism ML PQ2_0 ternary model support for Radeon RX 7000 / 9000 series

releaseNotes.releaseNotes:
- Native AMD ROCm/HIP support for Windows
- Full support for Radeon RX 9070 / 9070 XT (RDNA 4, gfx1201 / gfx1200) and RX 7000 series (RDNA 3, gfx1100-gfx1151)
- Accelerated PrismML Bonsai ternary model inference (*-PQ2_0.gguf, *-Q2_0_g64.gguf)
